scope: Selected manuscript results. Complete coefficient-class operational score, SDP attainment and reconstruction, general sharp decoder and circular-Gaussian small-noise trace with clipping, continuous attained Gram frontier, enclosing-ellipse equivalence, explicit quadratic frontier, C2 grid certification and O(h^2) scaling, and criterion transfer. Unified extension: actual attainable-pair constraints, common-completion collisions, positive definiteness from identification, compactness and positive operational maximum over all coefficient curves. Continuous recovery, automatic smoothing, dense-chart propagation and endpoint integration are checked; the charts still require an unformalized planar topological argument. Approximate stability is proved for the actual compact encoder class conditional on exact-class identification. Unrestricted continuous rigidity, analytic identification and general endpoint-gradient specializations, and additional coverage-inventory obligations remain incomplete.
